name: manual_6b2f17
claim: Receiver acceptance is not content-identity proof: ok, received_at and a matching byte count establish that a receiver accepted a transfer, not that the receiver holds the intended bytes. Treat delivery as content-verified only when the receiver reports or independently verifies a matching cryptographic digest. For reciprocal delivery claims also require a verified peer CA on the connection and a receipt hash computed by the receiver itself; otherwise report accepted delivery with the content-identity limitation.

decisions.notes: Adds the verified peer CA and receiver-computed receipt hash requirement for reciprocal delivery claims while preserving the acceptance versus content-identity distinction; the earlier record is preserved.

rationale: Adds the verified peer CA and receiver-computed receipt hash requirement for reciprocal delivery claims while preserving the acceptance versus content-identity distinction; the earlier record is preserved.
